concerns.text: SC-004 (≥95% of outputs with valid reasoning string + grounding score) has no covering task. T008 computes metrics and T012 reports 'SC-001–SC-012 status' generically, but no task verifies or evaluates the SC-004 threshold against computed artifacts. Add an explicit SC-004 check (e.g., in T008 verification or T013 artifact checks).

SC-009 requires reporting the grounding-uncertainty proportion AND triggering 'a supplemental data-quality analysis' if it exceeds 10%. T008 computes n_ambiguous and T012 reports status, but no task implements the conditional supplemental data-quality analysis. Add a conditional step or explicit failure-handling clause.

FR-019 states 'the required sample size (videos) shall be recorded and met'. T009 computes power/detectable effect size post hoc but no task records the required sample size BEFORE sampling (T006's fixed-seed sample rule) or verifies the achieved sample meets it. The a priori character of FR-019 is uncovered.

Plan element not covered: the plan specifies all steps 'orchestrated by python -m src.pipeline.run_all' under src/pipeline/, but no task creates an orchestrator or uses that layout (tasks use code/src/ per-stage commands). Either add a run_all-equivalent orchestration task or note the layout deviation explicitly so the plan element has a matcher.

Plan Phase 7 includes 'a tiny full-precision sample' alongside the 8-bit subset; T010's --quant-control covers only 8-bit vs 4-bit. Minor plan-element under-coverage — either add the full-precision sample or note its omission.
